comparisons.reason: Different constructs. Item 0 flags a comment arguing the OP's own premises or claims are internally contradictory or inconsistent. Item 85 flags a comment that opens by wholesale rejecting the OP's view without first acknowledging any validity. Item 0 is about the content of the criticism (internal inconsistency). Item 85 is about the opening rhetorical stance, so it can be met with no internal-contradiction claim. The null rules also differ: item 0 returns null if title and argument are both missing, while item 85 returns null only if OC_comments is missing or malformed.
